context: The EU layer holds frameworks and EU-wide networks only. Aid, land banks and courses are applied for nationally or regionally and belong in country or region files.
Commission pages describe measures of a strategy (for example a European Land Observatory); record them as announced until a page shows a working service.
Commission news articles explain policy; add them as news only when they report a dated event (adoption, launch, call, new figures) of the edition year.
Farmers do not apply to EU financial instruments directly: they are offered through national or regional guarantee and loan schemes, which belong in country or region files.

log.summary: First pass: reviewed the three Commission and EU CAP Network portals and wrote the 2026 EU edition with three resources; no 2026 EU event verified as news.
Resolved the two open leads: the Observatory on Farmland recorded as announced; EIB instruments rejected at EU level.

Prepublication discovery: ran prepublication-2026-09-25 queries. This is a search-result scan, not a complete review or evidence of absence. Candidate pages, all families and practical details still require verification. The scan does not update edition statuses or dates.
